description: This source file defines the HardcodedColorDetector class used within an Android Lint plugin to detect hardcoded color values in resource XML files. It includes logic to identify hardcoded colors directly in XML attributes, style items, and color definitions, and reports issues when such usages are found.

classes.name: HardcodedColorDetector
classes.description: A detector that scans resource XML files in Android projects to find instances of hardcoded color values that should be replaced with theme attributes for better theming support.

methods.name: isHardcodedColor
methods.description: Checks if a color string matches common hex color patterns (3, 6, or 8 hex digits) indicating a hardcoded color.

methods.name: addIndirectColor
methods.description: Stores references to colors used indirectly via resource references for later reporting.
